description: The Office of Congresswoman Abigail Spanberger (VA-07) seeks a driven, detail-oriented, hardworking, and engaged individual to work with her team. District research: research and compile information for district events and outreach
Communications: collaborate with the Communications team on tasks as needed such as compiling news clips and tracking social media accounts

Has knowledge of the district, its constituents, and its needs
Able to problem solve, think quickly, adapt, and handle sensitive information

How do you want to impact the community? Applications will be considered on a rolling basis until December 2nd, 2022.
